# EMERGENCY: MEDICAL EMERGENCY
# Generated by SolarPunk — 2026-03-28

1. ORS RECIPE: 6tsp sugar+0.5tsp salt+1L clean water. Sip slowly. Prevents fatal dehydration. WHO approved. Saves children.

2. BLEEDING: Direct pressure w/ clean cloth. Tourniquet ONLY limb+life-threatening=above wound+tight. Burns=cool water 10min. NO ice.

3. WATER SAFE: Boil 1min (3min above 2000m). Solar: clear bottle in sun 6hrs. Cholera prevention=boil+wash hands+cook food.

4. HELP: MSF msf.org=conflict zones. PCRF pcrf.net=Gaza children. ICRC icrc.org=surgical teams. All free. No questions.
